title: Transferable Design Themes
description: Portable visual-system briefs for twenty-one distinct design directions across websites and digital products; additional related art-direction variations are nested under their parent theme.

usage.principle: Treat each theme as a system of visual and interaction rules, not a color preset.
adaptation: Map the palette to the host site's brand and accessibility requirements while preserving the theme's signature contrast.
Apply the layout, typography, component, imagery, and motion guidance consistently across key pages.
Keep navigation, forms, and primary actions easy to find even when the visual treatment is experimental.
Use semantic HTML, keyboard-visible focus, reduced-motion support, and readable contrast.

tokens.colorValues: Hex values are starting points; tune them for contrast and brand fit.
tokens.fontFamilies: Font names are descriptive directions. Select licensed, available web fonts with similar characteristics.
tokens.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion and avoid flashing effects.

themes.name: Dada Riot
themes.concept: Punk zine meets anti-establishment art school: handmade, confrontational, and deliberately disruptive.

typography.display: Heavy condensed grotesk or distressed display sans
typography.body: Neutral sans-serif with strong legibility
typography.accent: Typewriter or handwritten annotation style, used sparingly
typography.treatment: Mix scale and alignment like cut-and-paste print media while keeping text hierarchy clear.

principles: Collage compositions
Overlapping blocks
Tilted panels
Torn-paper or rough-edge motifs
Intentional grid breaks
layout.density: High-energy focal areas balanced by clear reading paths and calmer content zones.

themes.imagery: Photocopy textures, scanned paper, cutout photography, halftones, ink marks, and imperfect print registration.
themes.motion: Brief irregular shifts, paper flicks, rough reveals, and sharp cuts; keep movement purposeful and restrained.
guardrails: Preserve a clear reading order.
Do not make every element chaotic.
Keep essential controls conventional and easy to locate.

themes.name: Neo-Brutalist Jester
themes.concept: A hard-edged digital printshop: bold, direct, playful, and slightly unruly.

typography.display: Oversized heavy grotesk or condensed sans
typography.body: Plain, highly readable sans-serif
typography.accent: Compact uppercase labels and blunt microcopy
typography.treatment: Use scale, weight, and tight line breaks for impact; keep body text calm.

principles: Strong columns
Large color blocks
Thick black borders
Offset shadows
Hard corners
Visible grid structure
layout.density: Bold focal elements with enough whitespace to make each block legible.

themes.imagery: Graphic poster art, flat illustrations, strong cutouts, high-contrast photography, and simple geometric shapes.
themes.motion: Snappy slides, hard cuts, cursor-led accents, and small positional shifts that support the print-poster character.
guardrails: Do not turn every panel into a headline.
Reserve the strongest color for key actions and emphasis.
Keep small text readable against saturated backgrounds.

themes.name: Neon Trickster
themes.concept: Digital nightlife and cyberpunk interface, with a clever guide moving through an electric, high-energy system.

typography.display: Geometric display sans with futuristic proportions
typography.body: Neutral sans-serif optimized for dark interfaces
typography.accent: Monospace labels for data, states, and technical details
typography.treatment: Use luminous color for short emphasis, never for long passages.

principles: Dark interface panels
Luminous outlines
Layered cards
Technical grids
Selective visual distortion
layout.density: Structured dashboard-like zones punctuated by vivid focal panels.

themes.imagery: Night-city scenes, abstract light trails, holographic surfaces, digital textures, and high-contrast character art.
themes.motion: Subtle pulses, controlled flickers, parallax, and card transitions; avoid flashing or destabilizing text.
guardrails: Maintain strong contrast for text and controls.
Keep essential text stable and free of glitch effects.
Use animation selectively and support reduced-motion preferences.

themes.name: Luxury Bento / Velvet Gallery
themes.concept: A private exhibition space: refined, composed, and editorial, with modern modular layouts.

typography.display: Elegant editorial serif
typography.body: Clean contemporary sans-serif
typography.accent: Small, letter-spaced gallery labels
typography.treatment: Use contrast between expressive headlines and restrained supporting text.

principles: Asymmetrical bento grids
Generous margins
Curated image panels
Deliberate scale changes
Quiet visual rhythm
layout.density: Moderate density with careful spacing and a small number of strong focal points.

themes.imagery: Art-directed photography, tactile materials, sculptural objects, gallery interiors, and restrained color grading.
themes.motion: Slow fades, gentle image reveals, subtle hover lift, and smooth transitions.
guardrails: Avoid generic luxury clichés.
Do not let oversized margins hide important content.
Keep buttons and navigation visibly interactive.

themes.name: The Impossible Court
themes.concept: Surrealist theatre inside an impossible palace: strange, elegant, and designed around discovery.

typography.display: Dramatic literary serif
typography.body: Restrained readable sans-serif
typography.accent: Small theatrical labels or chapter markers
typography.treatment: Pair evocative titles with plain-language navigation and explanatory text.

principles: Unusual scale
Doorway and frame motifs
Floating panels
Unexpected but navigable transitions
Scene-based sections
layout.density: Sparse, cinematic compositions with clearly signposted content destinations.

themes.imagery: Impossible architecture, dreamlike landscapes, theatrical lighting, symbolic objects, and surreal still-life compositions.
themes.motion: Slow spatial transitions, shifting perspective, floating objects, and restrained scroll-linked scene changes.
guardrails: Do not turn navigation into a puzzle.
Always show users where they are and how to continue.
Provide a static, accessible experience when motion is unavailable or reduced.

themes.name: The Forbidden Library
themes.concept: A secret archive of knowledge: scholarly, atmospheric, and slightly dangerous.

typography.display: Bookish serif with strong character
typography.body: Highly legible text face for sustained reading
typography.accent: Archival monospace or small-cap catalog labels
typography.treatment: Use a clear typographic hierarchy for titles, annotations, source notes, and body copy.

principles: Reading-focused pages
Catalog indexes
Marginal notes
Footnotes
Document-like panels
Clear source trails
layout.density: Content-rich but orderly, with a strong distinction between primary text and annotations.

themes.imagery: Manuscripts, engraved illustrations, book textures, archival photography, ink drawings, and warm directional light.
themes.motion: Subtle page-like reveals, ink transitions, gentle light shifts, and restrained movement between archive sections.
guardrails: Avoid faux-aged styling that harms readability.
Keep contrast strong and sources easy to scan.
Do not let decorative textures compete with long-form text.

themes.name: Punk Utility Brutalism
themes.concept: A high-contrast conversion system that combines punk energy with the clarity of a digital operating platform.

typography.display: Heavy grotesk or condensed sans-serif in oversized uppercase
typography.body: Compact, highly legible sans-serif
typography.accent: Small uppercase labels for status, category, and section metadata
typography.treatment: Use tight headline line-height, blunt phrasing, and electric-green emphasis on a few key words.

principles: Conversion-led landing-page sequence
Strong horizontal section rules
Large, high-impact hero
Hard-edged grids and cards
Optional alternation between dark and light sections
Clear repeated calls to action
layout.density: Compact and information-rich, with a clear hierarchy from headline to proof, process, resources, and action.

components: Electric-green CTA buttons with hard offset shadows
themes.imagery: Use sparse, purposeful imagery. Let typography, grids, color blocks, subtle dot textures, and product screenshots carry the visual identity.
themes.motion: Use short, direct transitions such as sharp reveals, small shifts, and button press feedback. Keep motion subordinate to the CTA and content.
guardrails: Keep the main CTA obvious and repeat it at useful decision points.
Use electric green as a signal color rather than a background for every section.
Maintain readable body text and comfortable spacing on mobile.
Keep the layout crisp and functional; avoid adding glitch effects or ornamental chaos.

referenceVariants.distinction: Dark foundation, white cards, and green offset edges.
Alternating dark and light sections with bold bordered cards.
Dark dotted-grid treatment with green rules and compact utility labels.

themes.name: Celestial Capital
themes.concept: A cinematic investment house at the edge of the atmosphere: institutional credibility expressed through an illuminated orbital horizon, refined editorial typography, and quiet portfolio storytelling.

typography.display: High-contrast editorial serif with elegant proportions; optional italic word or phrase for cinematic emphasis.
typography.body: Quiet contemporary grotesk with high legibility and generous tracking where appropriate.
typography.accent: Small uppercase or widely tracked labels for portfolio sectors, fund details, and navigation.
typography.treatment: Center the short editorial hero; contrast expressive serif display type with compact sans-serif proof and restrained numerical metrics.

principles: Full-bleed dark hero with one luminous orbital arc or atmospheric horizon
Minimal, widely spaced navigation anchored above the visual field
Centered editorial headline and compact dual-CTA cluster
Spacious investment-vertical index with curated imagery
Portfolio/company listings with deliberate editorial rhythm
Quiet metrics band, thesis/values sections, and people-led narrative
Alternation between cinematic scenes and calm structured reading areas
layout.density: Sparse and cinematic at entry; moderately information-rich in portfolio, track record, and team sections.

components: Thin separators and understated hover reveals
themes.imagery: Dark atmospheric horizons, abstract planetary glow, carefully art-directed founder and portfolio photography, architectural detail, and soft spectral gradients. One hero spectacle carries the mood; supporting imagery should feel credible and restrained.
themes.motion: Slow atmospheric light drift, subtle image reveals, smooth editorial section transitions, and restrained hover shifts. The orbital effect must work as a static still for reduced-motion settings.
guardrails: Avoid turning the celestial arc into repeated decorative wallpaper.
Never use decorative light to obscure the headline or calls to action.
Keep real portfolio data, fund information, and performance claims distinguishable from examples.
Do not confuse cinematic pacing with slow loading or hidden navigation.
Maintain readable contrast, predictable navigation, and reduced-motion support.

themes.name: Liquid Amethyst AI
themes.concept: A dark creative workshop animated by one sculptural, liquid-amethyst object; vivid purple materiality and tightly composed utility cards make advanced AI creation feel tangible.

typography.display: Contemporary geometric or neo-grotesk sans with confident, compact headlines.
typography.body: Neutral modern sans-serif designed for dark UI panels.
typography.accent: Bright purple highlight words and small readable process labels.
typography.treatment: Use medium-to-heavy weight rather than extra-condensed aggression; let the sculpture deliver visual drama while text explains the product.

principles: Dark rounded hero stage with a split headline and oversized sculptural 3D form
Purple branded framing surface surrounding darker content panels
Compact social-proof strip directly below hero
Three-step creation process rendered as adjacent dark cards
Feature modules alternating practical explanations and creative outputs
Clear path from brief upload to generation, refinement, and export
Controlled spacing with dense feature details below the hero
layout.density: Moderate: a strong sculptural focal point plus closely grouped process and feature cards.

themes.imagery: Glossy translucent purple rings, molten glass, metallic folds, refracted violet highlights, stylized AI-created outputs, and authentic product preview imagery. Favor a coherent material language over unrelated sci-fi illustrations.
themes.motion: Slow object rotation or light sweep, tactile card elevation, and short generation-state transitions. Use a static optimized render on small screens or with reduced motion.
guardrails: Maintain a real product explanation rather than relying on the 3D sculpture alone.
Never let glossy effects impair download, upload, or form usability.
Keep purple accent text short enough to retain contrast.
Avoid large 3D assets that slow mobile loading.
Do not reuse the sculptural hero in every section; reserve it as the focal signature.

themes.name: Lime Precision Fintech
themes.concept: A precision-built financial command surface: an almost-black conversion hero punctuated by signal lime gives way to bright, rounded dashboards that make financial control feel immediate and trustworthy.

typography.display: Clean, confident contemporary sans-serif with large but not distorted proportions.
typography.body: Highly legible neo-grotesk sans with tabular numerals for balances and charts.
typography.accent: Small uppercase product labels, financial metric captions, and concise status tags.
typography.treatment: Use an economical centered hero hierarchy; let crisp currency figures, UI labels, and card balances provide the second typographic layer.

principles: Near-black hero with one lime primary CTA and restrained halo glow
Large realistic dashboard preview overlapping or immediately following hero
Bright interior product UI contrasted against dark marketing frame
Three-step account-to-insight-to-goal explanation
Organized bento-like product feature cards for balance, spending, and goals
Clear pricing or waitlist path and contextual conversion points
Dense financial information contained within calm, rounded panels
layout.density: Low at the top for trust and immediate understanding; moderate inside product demonstrations and metric cards.

components: Account balance and payment card mockups
themes.imagery: Use authentic product UI, balance cards, clean charts, card controls, and mobile-device mockups rather than stock photos or abstract financial symbols. White panels should look like a plausible working application.
themes.motion: Smooth dashboard entrance, short number updates, gentle chart reveals, and subtle lime-button glow. Motion should indicate state changes without mimicking fake financial activity.
guardrails: Keep the visual language polished and rounded; do not import harsh neo-brutalist offsets or distressed type.
Use lime sparingly as an action and highlight color, not across every data tile.
Never present sample balances or results as verified customer outcomes.
Do not use color alone to express financial status.
Keep tables, charts, and forms keyboard accessible and legible on mobile.

typography.display: Large, bold neo-grotesk sans-serif with precise line breaks and very limited decoration.
typography.body: Compact neutral sans-serif with strong light-on-dark contrast.
typography.accent: Small badge labels, service tags, and unobtrusive trust metadata.
typography.treatment: Keep white headlines optically centered over the glow; reserve violet for short badges, CTAs, selected terms, and environmental illumination.

principles: Full-screen or tall dark hero organized around a single violet halo, ring, or horizon glow
Centered bold headline with compact service proposition and dual CTAs
Minimal navigation, spaced proof row, and generous dark negative space
Transition from atmospheric hero into practical services and portfolio sections
Optional starfield or sparse particulate detail only around the hero
Project showcases in editorial rows instead of one endless uniform card grid
Supporting process, pricing, and contact sections retain clean functional geometry

components: Minimal navigation with violet contact action
Quiet dark pricing and FAQ modules

guardrails: Do not confuse this with Neon Trickster: avoid cyberpunk magenta/cyan overload, glitch typography, and holographic UI noise.
Use one primary atmospheric glow per view rather than multiple competing effects.
Ensure project proof and services are real and easy to find below the spectacle.
Keep primary CTAs high-contrast without relying on glow for legibility.
Provide static alternatives and reduced-motion support.

principles: Bright uncluttered hero focused on a concrete automation outcome

Connected-agent diagram and task handoff illustrations

components: Clean demo booking or access CTA

typography.display: Bold contemporary neo-grotesk sans with exacting, compact headlines.

themes.imagery: Prioritize interface captures, builder canvases, API diagrams, voice waveform examples, and restrained grid geometry. Keep abstract visuals subordinate to functional product demonstrations.
themes.motion: Short, precise tab switching, waveform playback feedback, clear menu transitions, and restrained grid-based reveals. Reduce-motion mode keeps all diagrams, samples, and labels usable.
guardrails: The red accent indicates primary action, not an implied system error across every panel.
Avoid loading the page with fake code, fake endpoints, or nonfunctional demo controls.
Keep grid lines faint enough not to compete with text.
Provide obvious paths to documentation, authentication, and pricing.
Avoid the heavy offset shadows and poster styling associated with neo-brutalism.
Make technical demonstrations accessible, labeled, and understandable.

themes.imagery: High-fashion editorial photography meets underground nightlife and provocative independent publishing. Cinematic, sensual, intimate, and visually driven. Subjects: close cinematic portraits, real nightlife rooms, hotel bars and corridors, backstage reflections, evidence-like still lifes, wet streets and nocturnal exteriors. Lighting: direct on-camera flash, low-key practical light, hard contrast, reflected light. Treatment: natural film grain, deep shadows without losing subject detail, asymmetric crops, selective desaturation, occasional colored practical lighting. Use licensed or owned production imagery; editorial fashion references inform art direction, not unlicensed publication reuse.
themes.motion: subtle image reveal; slow crop or parallax; understated link underline; brief page transition. Reduced motion: respect prefers-reduced-motion.

uniform bento repetition
generic luxury stock portraits

Folio and issue identity
Typography-led hierarchy with strong photographic art direction

themes.name: Capital Flight Deck

typography.body: Modern readable sans-serif for multi-account finance data
typography.accent: Tabular monospace for timestamps, account identifiers and source states
typography.treatment: Lead with one capital-health figure; reserve glowing color for live states and actionable exceptions.

principles: Persistent navigation rail with scoped business switcher
Prioritized status heartbeat across liquidity, exposure and runway
Large central time-series chart as the operational horizon
Right-side exception and decision queue
Compact account and credit tables with drill-downs
Visible sync status and as-of timestamps
layout.density: High information density with one dominant decision area and clearly segregated operational modules.

components: Credit availability versus outstanding utilization panel
themes.imagery: Precise financial instrumentation, thin vector grids, subtle depth and restrained luminous data traces; avoid generic rocket or spaceship illustrations.
themes.motion: Measured chart sweeps and diagnostic state transitions, not continuously moving gauges; respect reduced-motion.
guardrails: Do not imply derived eligibility is confirmed funding availability.
Display currency, coverage, freshness and source on critical metrics.
Alerts must link to a relevant detail or remediation action.
Distinguish demonstration numbers from connected account data.
Keep keyboard interaction and reduced-motion support.
